affordances.name: VirtualCity Environment
affordances.semantic: The loaded VirtualCity.glb model serving as the urban plaza environment with horizontal surfaces for furniture placement

affordances.name: SheenChair Asset
affordances.semantic: The loaded SheenChair.glb model used as the template for placeable furniture instances

affordances.name: Place Chair Button
affordances.semantic: Button that activates placement mode allowing user to click city surfaces to stamp chair instances

affordances.name: Chair Budget Display
affordances.semantic: HUD element showing remaining furniture budget units (starts at 8, decrements on place, increments on remove)

affordances.name: Rotation Slider
affordances.semantic: Slider control (0-360) that rotates the currently selected chair around its Y-axis

affordances.name: Scale Slider
affordances.semantic: Slider control (0.5-2.0) that resizes selected chair; scaling above 1.5 costs extra budget, scaling down refunds

affordances.name: Undo Button
affordances.semantic: Button that reverts the most recent operation from the undo stack

affordances.name: Redo Button
affordances.semantic: Button that reapplies the most recently undone operation from the redo stack

affordances.name: Placed Chair Instance
affordances.semantic: A cloned chair instance placed in the scene, selectable by clicking, removable to refund budget

states.name: Initial Load
states.description: Application starts, assets are loading, no chairs placed, budget at 8, undo/redo stacks empty

states.name: Assets Loaded Ready
states.description: Both VirtualCity and SheenChair models loaded, scene rendered, user can begin placing furniture
states.condition: window.__3D_STATE__ && window.__3D_STATE__.cityModelLoaded === true && window.__3D_STATE__.chairAssetLoaded === true && window.__3D_STATE__.chairsPlaced === 0 && window.__3D_STATE__.chairBudget === 8

states.name: First Chair Placed
states.description: User has placed one chair instance, budget reduced to 7, undo stack has 1 operation, chair is selectable

states.name: Multiple Chairs Active
states.description: Several chairs placed across the plaza, budget partially consumed, undo stack tracks all operations

states.name: Chair Selected and Modified
states.description: A chair is selected with rotation/scale sliders active, modifications tracked in undo stack, budget may adjust if scale crosses 1.5 threshold

states.name: Undo/Redo Operations
states.description: User has performed undo operations, redo stack populated, budget and chair count reflect reverted state

states.name: Budget Exhausted
states.description: Chair budget at 0, placement disabled, user must remove or scale down chairs to free budget, undo/redo still functional

postconditions: Both cityModelLoaded and chairAssetLoaded are true

action.code: document.querySelector('button').click(); setTimeout(() => { const canvas = document.querySelector('canvas'); const rect = canvas.getBoundingClientRect(); const x = rect.left + rect.width * 0.5; const y = rect.top + rect.height * 0.6; canvas.dispatchEvent(new MouseEvent('click', {clientX: x, clientY: y, bubbles: true})); }, 500);

postconditions: One chair placed in the scene

action.code: for(let i=0; i<3; i++) { document.querySelector('button').click(); setTimeout(() => { const canvas = document.querySelector('canvas'); const rect = canvas.getBoundingClientRect(); const x = rect.left + rect.width * (0.3 + i*0.15); const y = rect.top + rect.height * 0.55; canvas.dispatchEvent(new MouseEvent('click', {clientX: x, clientY: y, bubbles: true})); }, 300 + i*800); }

const canvas = document.querySelector('canvas'); const rect = canvas.getBoundingClientRect(); canvas.dispatchEvent(new MouseEvent('click', {clientX: rect.left + rect.width*0.5, clientY: rect.top + rect.height*0.6, bubbles: true})); setTimeout(() => { const rotSlider = document.querySelector('input[type=range]'); if(rotSlider) { rotSlider.value = 180; rotSlider.dispatchEvent(new Event('input', {bubbles: true})); } }, 800); setTimeout(() => { const sliders = document.querySelectorAll('input[type=range]'); if(sliders[1]) { sliders[1].value = 1.6; sliders[1].dispatchEvent(new Event('input', {bubbles: true})); } }, 1600);

postconditions: largeScaleChairs incremented, budget adjusted for extra cost

action.code: const undoBtn = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('button')).find(b => b.textContent.includes('Undo')); if(undoBtn) { undoBtn.click(); setTimeout(() => undoBtn.click(), 600); }

const redoBtn = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('button')).find(b => b.textContent.includes('Redo')); if(redoBtn) { redoBtn.click(); setTimeout(() => redoBtn.click(), 400); } for(let i=0; i<6; i++) { setTimeout(() => { document.querySelector('button').click(); setTimeout(() => { const canvas = document.querySelector('canvas'); const rect = canvas.getBoundingClientRect(); canvas.dispatchEvent(new MouseEvent('click', {clientX: rect.left + rect.width*(0.25+i*0.1), clientY: rect.top + rect.height*0.5, bubbles: true})); }, 200); }, 1000 + i*700); }

postconditions: Additional chairs placed to exhaust budget
